name: Vercel AI SDK
desc: TypeScript toolkit for streaming LLM UIs across providers
desc_zh: 面向 TypeScript 的流式 LLM UI 工具包，统一多家模型接口
solves: Streaming model output onto a page token by token is easy to get janky and messy when you write it yourself. These ready-made components survive a model swap.
solves_zh: 在网页上逐字渲染模型输出，自己写容易卡、容易乱。这里有现成流式组件，换模型不用重写。
best_for: You are building a streaming AI chat interface into your own product.
best_for_zh: 要给自己的产品做一个流式输出的 AI 对话界面。
